notes: THE SUBJECT. Spurs '16 — Parker (vol 59, playvol 73), Green (16/32), Leonard (85/48), Aldridge (88/25), Duncan (37/51).

helio 63.9 -> 58.6 and the five reads BALANCED 60.0. The next fits are pnr 56.0 and pickpop 56.0, so the read falls to the free default, not onto another shape; he has not said what it should be and nothing was steered to make one win.

Leonard is STILL the five's best scorer-creator (80.4) and still the man `featured('helio')` names. What changed is that the fit is now built on his helio-engine score, 80.4 - 0.45 x (65 - 48) = 72.8.

WHY A GATE AND NOT A REWRITE. scorerCreator is a weighted SUM — 0.45 x volume + 0.3 x efficiency + 25 x creation — so the playmaking side is worth at most 25 of ~100 and a big efficient scoring load carries a man who never ran anything to the top of it. His ruling makes the helio engine a CONJUNCTION, so the helio read (and only the helio read) charges the missing side: HELIO_PV_W 0.45 per point of play volume under HELIO_PV 65, continuous, no cliff, no floor, one formula for everyone.

WHERE 65 COMES FROM. It is measured, not chosen: over the 1,255 wheel fives the men the engine picks as helio engines have a MEDIAN play volume of 65 (p25 50, p75 77). The whole board's first options run p50 58; the card pool runs p75 60. A man at or above the median offence-runner pays nothing.

MEASURED AND REJECTED (1): ranking the whole floor by the gated score instead of the engine alone. It inflates the separation term — the four men beside the star are charged too — and 40 fives GAINED helio, including nine Phoenix Suns seasons. The separation term must keep reading scorerCreator.

MEASURED AND REJECTED (2): the softer pairs. (58, 0.40) and (62, 0.40) leave the Spurs reading helio at 61.2 and 60.0; (58, 0.60) drops them to 59.8, a quarter of a point under the free default, which is a knife edge rather than a ruling. (65, 0.45) lands them at 58.6, 1.4 clear, and is the pair whose line is a measured median rather than a number picked to clear the subject.

MEASURED AND REJECTED (3): a harder line. (70, 0.50) takes helio to 123 of 1,255 and (74, 0.75) to 94, which starts charging men like Jordan '98 (playvol 58) and Barkley '91 (59) out of a shape they belong in. The head never falls at any pair tested, but the middle does, so the line stayed at the measured median.
